evidence:
Reviewed frozen HEAD 3abee5a6add69443e49322e96f9130b834686235 against 565def869ae50e47e6da7388ea333229050eaf8d, the named intent documents, relevant diffs, actual consumer/service/store/transport code and surrounding contracts. The literal silent return is real: src/harness/agy/delivery.rs:643-675 initializes diagnostic=None; :1152-1155 and :1173-1180 preserve it for Refused/ApiError. cli/hook.rs:3231-3251 propagates that optional field unchanged, and :3920-3921 writes stderr only for Some. However, the claim does not establish a material violation of this change's stated contract.
(a) Present elsewhere: the new bounded diagnostic exists for the specified malformed successful-page/encoding mismatch case (delivery.rs:1100-1129,1240-1247; tests/harness/agy_delivery.rs:2965-2996). task-15-framing-refinement-proposal.md:46 expressly scopes the diagnostic to a page whose echoed render/output_bytes disagrees with measured native output. A Refused reply or service ApiError is a different outcome; the service never supplied a malformed successful page. No general persistent-failure diagnostic mechanism was found; its absence alone does not extend the scoped requirement.
(b) Within contract, refutation lands: the retained adapter output discipline is empty delivery on internal errors (src/harness/agy/delivery.rs:3-7; src/harness/adapter.rs:783-792; integrations/agy/README.md:130-136). The frozen-codec case is an explicit accepted refusal/repair limit, not promised automatic progress: TRUST-POLICY.md:1677-1679 and task-15-framing-refinement-proposal.md:88,122. service/delivery_presentation.rs:143-156 implements that refusal before allocation/retirement. TRUST-POLICY.md:1572-1579 requires corrupt private state to refuse, and :1599-1603 expressly excludes progress during perpetual admission/storage failure. None of these requires every such failure to set a stderr diagnostic. The general agent-usage.md:229 stderr statement describes Claude/Codex Current tool-boundary hooks, whereas AGY PreInvocation's adapter Observer step uses the separate output discipline. Quiet healthy turns and failed delivery can share empty output under that discipline.
(c) Scope: a general persistent-failure reason channel would be an additional observability requirement. The finding's bounded stderr proposal is reasonable, but reasonableness does not make it part of the reviewed contract.
(d) Materiality: no dropped invitation, receipt settlement, token retirement, or false emission confirmation is demonstrated. The diagnosed stalls themselves are explicitly accepted refusal/storage-failure cases; this finding changes their diagnostic visibility only. It does not show violation of the scoped mismatch diagnostic, admission or durable refusal guarantees.
(e) Pre-existing: generic silent failure/refusal handling already exists at base src/harness/agy/delivery.rs:823-839; base cli/hook.rs:3131-3144 always assigns diagnostic=None to the step. Base service/delivery_pull.rs:309-310 already returns NoHookPull, and :473-479 can return persistent paging refusal/StoreCorrupt, also silently consumed. V2 adds concrete error sources but preserves this output policy; its introduction does not establish an obligation to report every reason. This is not a confirmed defect needing the preExisting exception because the contractual refutation already lands.
(f) Linter territory: no; this is a behavioral/observability proposal. No tests, Cargo, product runtime or Herdr commands were executed. Structural evidence suffices; no external-world premise or web citation is needed.
